about: Diagrams (.bmap): the diagram editor in the preview, Quick Generate from a node, export as an image, their file type, their settings and their styles. Everything about them lives in this folder; the core only offers extension points. Both ends read 'fileTypes' (the server through File types, the browser through the copy tools/protocol-sync.mjs writes), and the settings are declared here ('contributes'), so Shell knows their defaults and shows their fields before any code runs. The type's label is 'Brainstorm Diagram': 'Diagram' alone is every diagram's word (Mermaid's too).
name: bmap-diagram

field.label: Auto-pan diagrams to content on open
